name: whiteboard
description: Collaborative whiteboard for Codex. Wraps the @kamiazya/whiteboard-mcp server and exposes the shared skills bundled with this plugin.

interface.longDescription: Exposes MCP tools so Codex can draw, annotate, and refine diagrams alongside you, and shows the same canvas in the hosted web app, updating within about a second, once the whiteboard browser extension connects it to your local daemon. Canvases live locally under ~/.whiteboard/ as OKF Markdown or JSON Canvas 1.0.
defaultPrompt: Sketch the architecture for this service on the whiteboard
Draw a request flow diagram and render the canvas as SVG
Open the whiteboard and annotate the current design
